cast.title: Visitation
cast.overview: 14-year-old Maria is sent to live with Catholic nuns as her mother is dying. Her arrival at the convent turns sinister when one of her caretakers becomes enamored with her for all the wrong reasons.

cast.title: The Quiet Ones
cast.overview: A professor and his students perform a dangerous experiment that causes a young woman to lose her sanity.

cast.title: The Signal
cast.overview: On a road trip, Nic and two friends are drawn to an isolated area by a computer genius. When everything suddenly goes dark, Nic regains consciousness – only to find himself in a waking nightmare.

cast.title: Ouija
cast.overview: A group of friends must confront their most terrifying fears when they awaken the dark powers of an ancient spirit board.

cast.title: Breeders
cast.overview: Described as a social horror-thriller that is tonally in the vein of the movie "Fresh" (2022). Premise TBA.

cast.title: The Good Mother
cast.overview: A journalist and her son's pregnant girlfriend attempt to track down those responsible for the murder of her estranged son. Together, they confront a world of drugs and corruption in the underbelly of their small city in upstate New York, where they uncover an even darker secret.

cast.title: Me and Earl and the Dying Girl
cast.original_title: Me and Earl and the Dying Girl
cast.overview: Greg is coasting through senior year of high school as anonymously as possible, avoiding social interactions like the plague while secretly making spirited, bizarre films with Earl, his only friend. But both his anonymity and friendship threaten to unravel when his mother forces him to befriend a classmate with leukemia.

cast.title: Ready Player One
cast.overview: When the creator of a popular video game system dies, a virtual contest is created to compete for his fortune.

cast.title: The Limehouse Golem
cast.overview: A series of murders has shaken the community to the point where people believe that only a legendary creature from dark times – the mythical Golem – must be responsible.

cast.title: Takes One to Know One
cast.overview: When Eleanor and Lucas meet in Rome, their chemistry is electric. With a shared passion for art, Italy and each other, it looks like the start of something life-changing. The biggest stumbling block: they're both in relationships with other people.

cast.title: Thoroughbreds
cast.overview: Lily and Amanda, two high school students living in suburban Connecticut, rekindle their unlikely friendship after years of drifting apart. Together, they devise a plan to kill Lily's abusive stepfather by hiring a lowlife drug dealer.

cast.title: Ruby's Skin
cast.overview: London 1865. Ruby discovers a dark secret about herself that her inventor father Derby has been keeping quiet for her entire life.

cast.title: Katie Says Goodbye
cast.overview: A kindhearted seventeen-year-old in the American Southwest turns to prostitution to fulfill her dream of a new life in San Francisco.

cast.title: A Talent for Murder
cast.overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

cast.title: Life Itself
cast.overview: As a young New York couple goes from college romance to marriage and the birth of their first child, the unexpected twists of their journey create reverberations that echo over continents and through lifetimes.

cast.title: The Tracking of a Russian Spy
cast.original_title: The Tracking of a Russian Spy
cast.overview: Mitch Swenson meets a mysterious Russian woman named Katya at a New York night club, only for her to vanish after she is arrested for being a Russian spy. Swenson heads to Moscow to track down the woman he loves.

cast.title: Follow the Roses
cast.overview: A young girl witnesses the outcome of her family's negligence.

cast.title: Sound of Metal
cast.overview: Metal drummer Ruben begins to lose his hearing. When a doctor tells him his condition will worsen, he thinks his career and life is over. His girlfriend Lou checks the former addict into a rehab for the deaf hoping it will prevent a relapse and help him adapt to his new life. After being welcomed and accepted just as he is, Ruben must choose between his new normal and the life he once knew.

cast.title: Little Fish
cast.overview: A couple fights to hold their relationship together as a memory loss virus spreads and threatens to erase the history of their love and courtship.

cast.title: Untitled Fairy Tale Project
cast.overview: A princess's spell from her fairy godmother has unintended consequences for the fairy tale universe.

cast.title: Naked Singularity
cast.overview: When a successful New York public defender loses his first case, he is pulled into a drug heist by a former client in an effort to beat the broken system at its own game.

cast.title: Pixie
cast.overview: To avenge her mother's death, Pixie masterminds a heist but must flee across Ireland from gangsters, take on the patriarchy, and choose her own destiny.

cast.title: Fireheart
cast.overview: The film explores the world of firefighters in 1920s New York City and tells the story of a 16-year-old girl who will have to become a hero in order to save her city.

cast.title: Emperor
cast.overview: After the daughter has introduced their story, you take on the role of the father during a speech therapy session. You try to perform different exercises with your hands. They are apparently simple, but your control is disrupted—you’re unable to express what you mean. And then early memories emerge, which prove stronger than the here-and-now of the exercises.

cast.title: Brides
cast.overview: In 1961, Sally Bishop and her husband vacation to Northern Italy, where they get stranded at a remote villa run by the enigmatic Vova, who presides over a household of beautiful, deathless women and their caretaker. As Sally becomes entangled in their world of seduction, violence and illusion, she begins to lose her grip on time and self as her own dark transformation unfolds.
